query:
SELECT
    CONCAT('cpo-', LOWER(name)) AS "identifier!",
    LOWER(name) AS "name!",
    slug_name AS display_name
FROM
    operator
WHERE
    EXISTS (SELECT operator_id FROM charge_price WHERE operator_id = id)
    AND $1 != ''
    AND ccs_plug_count > 0 OR type2_plug_count > 0
ORDER BY
    operator.name;
